content.content:
#### Days

Within Previous, tasks are grouped by the day they were sent, in the user's local time, each day headed by a divider row, 28 pixels tall like every row, its label in small muted text set in to line up with the rows' text: "Today", "Yesterday", the weekday for the rest of the past week, as "Tuesday", and the date beyond that, as "3 October", with the year added once it isn't this one, as "28 September 2025", then, muted after it, how many tasks that day holds. Days run oldest to newest, as the tasks do, and only days with a task are shown; a chain is under the day its first step was sent. While filters are on, a day with no task shown is left out, and its count is of the tasks shown. The labels follow the clock: one reading "Today" reads "Yesterday" once midnight has passed, without reopening the tab.
A day's divider is sticky beneath Previous's own heading: while its tasks are scrolled through, it stays pinned just below that heading, until the next day's divider pushes it out, so the day of the rows in view always shows. Day dividers take the place of the session dividers the previous tasks had; a session that starts a new conversation shows a small muted mark at its first row's right instead, its tooltip saying it started a new conversation.

#### Rows
44:Filtering only hides tasks from the list; it changes nothing about them. A chain whose steps are hidden in part keeps its parent row above the steps still shown, and is hidden with its parent only when none of its steps shows. Day dividers show only above a day with a task shown, as the [TasksTabScope](../../ui/components/right-sidebar/tasks/index.md#tasks-tab-scope) says. The row's count still counts every previous task, and while any option is checked, the Previous group's heading, after its count, reads " · N shown", N counting the previous tasks the filters show. A hidden task stays selected if it was, and is still counted in "N selected" and sent by the batch actions; an open task that is filtered out closes. With every task filtered out, the list reads "No previous tasks match these filters", muted, centred. The filters are kept while the list is closed and opened again, and each open project keeps its own, as the [OpenProjectsScope](../open-projects/index.md#open-projects-scope) says, but they are not saved with the project.
55:A chain is listed where its first step was sent, oldest first like every other item; tasks sent while it ran, such as questions or tasks of the other lane run between its steps, are never listed within it, and are listed after the chain, in the order they were sent. A chain's steps are found by which step each was sent from, not by being next to each other in the history. A chain still running, or one whose later steps haven't been sent yet, shows as many steps as have been, and a step still running shows as it would anywhere. When the latest task, heading the view, is a step of a chain, that chain's earlier steps are still grouped under its parent in the list, the parent saying the rest is the latest task. A chain is listed under the day its first step was sent, whatever day its later steps ran. A step from the history whose chain can't be worked out, as when the step it was sent from is missing, is listed as a task of its own.

content.text:
Previous tasks in the Tasks tab are now grouped by the day they were sent, under a divider row for each day. The build is clean and the tests pass. One of them, `long_output_is_measured_a_few_rows_a_frame`, is about task output rather than this change: it failed in the full run and passed when run alone. I haven't looked at the dividers in the running app.

- **Dividers:** each day has a 28px divider, lined up with the rows' text, showing its label and that day's task count. A chain counts each of its steps that's showing.
- **Labels:** "Today", "Yesterday", the weekday for the rest of the past week, then "3 October", with the year once it isn't this year. Days use your local time and run oldest to newest.
- **Midnight:** the labels redraw on their own when midnight passes.
- **Chains:** a chain sits under the day its first step was sent.
- **Filters:** days with no matching tasks are hidden, and each count only includes tasks the filter shows.
- **Sticky:** the divider for the day in view stays pinned just below the Previous heading until the next day's divider, or the Running heading, pushes it out.
- **New conversations:** a task or chain that started a new conversation shows a small muted icon at the right of its row, with a "Started a new conversation" tooltip.

A task whose send time can't be told counts as sent today. This follows the spec, which matches your prompt.
